text:
Rain was still tapping against the windows of the old lens-grinding hall on Marrow Street when word arrived that Fennimore Optics had a new owner. On 14 March 2031, Stradal Group announced it had acquired the firm, ending decades of independent work in a trade that Northfold has long counted among its quiet points of pride.

The deal, an all-cash purchase valued at 412 million credits, is set out in the joint merger filing lodged with the Calderon Basin Trade Registry. Helena Vörsch, Chief Executive of Stradal Group, confirmed the acquisition.

Fennimore began as a small workshop and grew slowly, rarely seeking attention. Its sale marks a turning point, and it invites a reflective question: what becomes of a craft when its custodian changes hands?
